_meta.purpose: Candidate review list for emerge_from_ground entrance-anim classification. Used during v0.24.80 playtest by alaric.
_meta.methodology: Combined TAE evidence (anim 9000 presence/absence from 396-chr corpus scan) with manual game-knowledge identification of ER chrs known to emerge from ground in vanilla gameplay. NOT auto-derived — pure TAE signal cannot distinguish emerge from generic scripted-intro at anim-ID level (validated across 396 chrs).
_meta.how_to_use: If a placement of one of these chrs at an unusual arena CTDs during playtest, add cp to data/entrance_animations.json with 'class': 'emerge_from_ground' and the new arena to data/nr_no_emerge_slots.json. Watch especially for placements at Fort GG (m30_30 pi=45) or any rampart/roof tile.

candidates.name: Wormface
candidates.game_knowledge_reason: Canonical ER lore — Wormface enemies erupt from soil when player approaches. Field placement in Caelid and Lake of Rot. STRONG candidate.
candidates.confidence_for_emerge: high (matches Erdtree Avatar / Land Squirt class)

candidates.name: Giant Ant
candidates.game_knowledge_reason: Ants emerge from underground tunnels in ER (Siofra River, Ainsel River). Field-boss tier in some encounters.

candidates.name: Skull Plate Giant Ant
candidates.game_knowledge_reason: Variant of c4280, same emerge intro family.

candidates.name: Fingercreeper
candidates.game_knowledge_reason: Fingercreepers sit flat on ground in vanilla; AI triggers rise-up on approach. Could be emerge or just "wake up from prone."

candidates.name: Giant Fingercreeper
candidates.game_knowledge_reason: Variant of c4240, GIGA boss tier. Same emerge concern.

candidates.name: Spiritcaller Snail (Great Church Boss)
candidates.game_knowledge_reason: Hidden in shell, emerges on damage. But typically pre-placed in scripted arenas — may NOT be emerge_from_ground per se.

candidates.name: Putrid Flesh
candidates.game_knowledge_reason: Putrid flesh blob emerges from corpse piles. Probable emerge intro.

candidates.name: Giant Putrid Flesh (Blood)
candidates.game_knowledge_reason: Variant of c4170, XXL boss. Same emerge concern.
